description: regreSSHion: signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's sshd allows remote code execution when an authenticated connection is not established within LoginGraceTime.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8/9.8p1 or apply the vendor patch and set LoginGraceTime to 0 as a temporary mitigation.

description: Privilege escalation vulnerability in the OpenSSH signal handler on GNU/Linux systems that use the __nss_ functions.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.8p1 or apply the distribution backported patch.

description: Terrapin attack: SSH protocol downgrade that allows prefix truncation of the extension negotiation message when using certain CBC and ChaCha20 chained MACs.
remediation: Disable affected MAC algorithms (chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com, hmac-sha2-* with CBC and chain) or upgrade to OpenSSH 9.6+.

description: Remote code execution in the ssh-agent PKCS#11 signature forwarding implementation when certain libraries are available to load.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.3p2/9.3p1 with the fix or disable PKCS#11 support in ssh-agent.

description: Authentication bypass in OpenSSH when a hostname is given without the '[]' brackets for IPv6 and the server enables ProxyUseFdpass.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.3p1 or a version patched for ProxyUseFdpass handling.

description: Apache HTTP Server path traversal and file disclosure (with potential RCE on CGI) in the 2.4.49 release.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache 2.4.50+ and disable any CGI handler echoes.

description: Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50, bypassing the CVE-2021-41773 fix.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later immediately.

description: HTTP request smuggling attack on Apache HTTP Server 2.4.55 and earlier via mlist or mod_proxy when configured as a reverse proxy.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.56 or later.

description: Server-Side Request Forgery in Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy when the server is configured as a reverse proxy.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.54 or later.

description: Off-by-one buffer overflow in the nginx resolver, allowing a DNS server to trigger memory corruption and potential RCE.
remediation: Upgrade to nginx 1.21.0, 1.20.1 or apply the official patch.

description: Memory corruption in nginx MP4 module triggered by specially crafted MP4 files, allowing RCE or a crash when ngx_http_mp4_module is enabled.
remediation: Upgrade to nginx 1.23.2, 1.22.1 or disable the MP4 module.

description: HTTP/3 null-pointer dereference in nginx QUIC module (ngx_http_v3_module) causing worker crash on crafted requests.
Vulnerability in vsftpd 2.3.4 with a known backdoor that opens port 6200 when a specific username is entered, granting a shell.
remediation: Upgrade vsftpd or remove the backdoored version 2.3.4 from production immediately.

description: SMTP smuggling in Postfix that allows an attacker to bypass SPF/DMARC protections and spoof emails against default configurations.
remediation: Upgrade Postfix to a patched version or restrict sender addresses to validated domains.

description: Command injection in the ProFTPD mod_sftp module allowing remote code execution via crafted file names when using the SCP protocol.
remediation: Upgrade to ProFTPD 1.3.8b/1.3.9 or disable the mod_sftp SFTP transport.

description: Buffer overflow in the WebDAV handler of Microsoft IIS 6.0 allowing remote code execution via crafted PROPFIND requests.
remediation: IIS 6.0 is end-of-life; migrate to a supported IIS/CGI proxy configuration immediately.
